cards.example_en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
cards.example_zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。
cards.explain_zh: 英式single/return ticket分别指单程票和往返票。

cards.example_en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
cards.example_zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
cards.example_zh: 我们长途步行回来后，爸爸做了一顿热乎乎的饭。
cards.explain_zh: meal指一顿饭；food泛指食物，通常不可数。

cards.example_en: My colleague brought homemade soup to the office today.
cards.example_zh: 我的同事今天把自制的汤带到了办公室。
cards.explain_zh: colleague指同事，不一定是朋友或同级员工。

cards.example_en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
cards.example_zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。
cards.explain_zh: a bag of后接所装物品，如a bag of rice。

cards.example_en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
cards.example_zh: 她把苹果放进了一个可重复使用的袋子里。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Could you repeat the address a little more slowly?
cards.example_zh: 你能把地址再慢一点说一遍吗？
cards.explain_zh: repeat已含“再次”之意，通常不必再加again。

cards.example_en: We divided the cake into equal pieces for everyone.
cards.example_zh: 我们把蛋糕切成大小相等的小块，分给大家。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词常接to；动词equal直接接宾语，不加to。

cards.example_en: Governments should ensure that children from all backgrounds have equal access to quality education and essential healthcare.
cards.example_zh: 政府应确保各种背景的儿童都能平等地获得优质教育和基本医疗服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: He sent flowers as an expression of his gratitude.
cards.example_zh: 他送了花来表达谢意。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“表情、说法”时可数；表示“表达”时常不可数。

cards.example_en: The room costs sixty pounds plus breakfast each night.
cards.example_zh: 房间每晚六十英镑，早餐另收费。
cards.explain_zh: plus作名词表示优点时可数，如a big plus。

cards.example_en: The soup was extremely hot, so I waited.
cards.example_zh: 汤烫极了，所以我等了一会儿。
cards.explain_zh: 修饰可分程度的形容词或副词，语气强于very。

cards.example_en: Access to reliable internet is extremely important for students who depend on online learning.
cards.example_zh: 对于依赖在线学习的学生来说，能够使用可靠的网络极其重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The owner of the bakery greets us every morning.
cards.example_zh: 面包店老板每天早上都向我们打招呼。
cards.explain_zh: 表示某物的所有者，用the owner of加名词。

cards.example_en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
cards.example_zh: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。
cards.explain_zh: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。

cards.example_en: Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
cards.example_zh: 乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This street has homes above its commercial premises.
cards.example_zh: 这条街的商业用房上面是住宅。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词指电视或广播广告，不泛指所有广告。

cards.example_en: Commercial development can create jobs, but it should not come at the expense of public green spaces.
cards.example_zh: 商业开发能够创造就业机会，但不应以牺牲公共绿地为代价。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A kind lady helped me find the station.
cards.example_zh: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了车站。
cards.explain_zh: woman是中性通用词；lady常用于礼貌称呼。

cards.example_en: An elderly lady at the meeting explained how the new bus route had improved her daily life.
cards.example_zh: 会上，一位年长女士讲述了新公交线路如何改善她的日常生活。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: It is my duty to keep these animals safe.
cards.example_zh: 保护这些动物的安全是我的责任。
cards.explain_zh: on duty指值班；具体岗位职责常用复数duties。

cards.example_en: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
cards.example_zh: 我使出全身力气才提起那个手提箱。
cards.explain_zh: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。

cards.example_en: Connect your phone to the speaker using this cable.
cards.example_zh: 用这根线把手机连接到音箱上。
cards.explain_zh: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

cards.example_en: The festival celebrates the town's rich cultural traditions.
cards.example_zh: 这个节日颂扬小镇丰富的文化传统。
cards.explain_zh: cultural指文化相关；cultured形容人有修养。

cards.example_en: The festival celebrates the cultural diversity of the local community.
cards.example_zh: 这个节日颂扬当地社区的文化多样性。

cards.example_en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
cards.example_zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。
cards.explain_zh: 安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

cards.example_en: The new bike scheme lets students borrow cycles cheaply.
cards.example_zh: 新的自行车方案让学生能便宜地借车。

cards.example_en: The shop accepts payment by card or cash.
cards.example_zh: 这家商店接受刷卡或现金付款。
cards.explain_zh: 支付行为通常不可数；一笔款项可用a payment。

cards.example_en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
cards.example_zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。
cards.explain_zh: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。

cards.example_en: We took a brief break before finishing the puzzle.
cards.example_zh: 我们短暂休息了一下，然后完成了拼图。
cards.explain_zh: brief指时间短或内容简洁，本身不表示草率。

cards.example_en: A small bird built a nest above our window.
cards.example_zh: 一只小鸟在我们窗户上方筑了巢。
cards.explain_zh: 鸟群用a flock of birds；bird本身是可数名词。

cards.example_en: These muddy footprints demonstrate that someone entered the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 这些泥脚印表明有人进过厨房。
cards.explain_zh: 证明某事常用demonstrate that从句。

cards.example_en: These muddy footprints demonstrate that someone entered the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 这些泥脚印表明有人进过厨房。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Your contribution helped us finish the garden before sunset.
cards.example_zh: 有了你的帮助，我们在日落前完成了花园的整理工作。
cards.explain_zh: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: I really appreciate you watering my plants while I was away.
cards.example_zh: 非常感谢你在我不在的时候帮忙给植物浇水。
cards.explain_zh: 可接名词或动名词，不接to do；感谢帮助用appreciate your help。

cards.example_en: I read one chapter before turning off the light.
cards.example_zh: 我读了一章才关灯。
cards.explain_zh: 书的“章”用chapter；章内较小部分常用section。

cards.example_en: We planned a secret picnic for our grandparents.
cards.example_zh: 我们悄悄为祖父母策划了一次野餐。
cards.explain_zh: 秘诀常用the secret to，to后接名词或动名词。

cards.example_en: Apparently, the bakery closes early on rainy days.
cards.example_zh: 听说那家面包店下雨天会提早关门。
cards.explain_zh: 表示据现有信息推测，不保证事实确实如此。

cards.example_en: I finished the novel on the train yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 我昨天在火车上读完了这部长篇小说。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词指长篇小说；作形容词指新颖的。

cards.example_en: The union helped staff negotiate better working hours.
cards.example_zh: 工会帮助员工协商争取到了更合理的工作时间。
cards.explain_zh: union以辅音/j/开头，因此说a union而非an union。

cards.example_en: Too much sun can burn your skin at the beach.
cards.example_zh: 在海滩上，阳光太强会晒伤你的皮肤。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词可用burnt或burned。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: Growing vegetables at home is a popular trend here.
cards.example_zh: 在家种菜是这里流行的一种风尚。
cards.explain_zh: 朝向某种趋势常用a trend towards后接名词。

cards.example_en: My initial excitement faded when I saw the price.
cards.example_zh: 看到价格后，我最初的兴奋消退了。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词通常放在名词前；姓名首字母常用initials。

cards.example_en: Although the initial cost of solar panels is high, households may save money over the longer term.
cards.example_zh: 虽然太阳能电池板的初期费用较高，但从长远看，家庭可能节省开支。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She takes great pleasure in growing herbs on her balcony.
cards.example_zh: 她在阳台上种香草，从中获得很大的乐趣。
cards.explain_zh: 快乐通常不可数；一件乐事可说a pleasure。

cards.example_en: Public libraries encourage reading for pleasure while providing affordable access to knowledge for people of all ages.
cards.example_zh: 公共图书馆鼓励以阅读为乐，同时让各年龄段的人都能以低廉的成本获取知识。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Your suggestion to bring a picnic was really helpful.
cards.example_zh: 你提议带上野餐食物，真是帮了大忙。
cards.explain_zh: suggestion是可数名词；advice通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Your support was critical when I started my business.
cards.example_zh: 我创业时，你的支持至关重要。
cards.explain_zh: critical of表示批评；critical to表示对……至关重要。

cards.example_en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员向当地居民收集信息，以了解公共交通如何影响就业机会的获取。
cards.explain_zh: I gather that...表示“我听说或推断……”。

cards.example_en: Researchers gather information from local residents to understand how public transport affects access to employment.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员向当地居民收集信息，以了解公共交通如何影响就业机会的获取。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Volunteers can make a contribution to the protection of local wildlife.
word.example_zh: 志愿者可以为保护当地野生生物作出贡献。
